title: The Puzzle Tree Adventure
moral: Helping each other makes solving problems fun and easy.

scenes.summary: Four friends begin a puzzle adventure.
scenes.text: Mia, Sam, Leo, and Noor started building a puzzle and went to find missing pieces.
scenes.image_prompt: kids sitting with puzzle pieces on carpet, bright cartoon

scenes.summary: They need to find hidden puzzle pieces.
scenes.text: They searched around the house for special puzzle pieces.
scenes.image_prompt: kids searching puzzle pieces under couch and near lamp, cartoon

scenes.summary: They explore different places like garden and sandbox.
scenes.text: They explored the backyard, sandbox, and laundry area to find pieces.
scenes.image_prompt: kids exploring backyard and sandbox for puzzle pieces, colorful cartoon

scenes.summary: They find all pieces and complete the puzzle.
scenes.text: They gathered all pieces and carefully put them together.
scenes.image_prompt: kids completing puzzle together, joyful cartoon

scenes.text: They felt proud, shared their story, and went to rest happily.
scenes.image_prompt: kids resting and smiling after puzzle, cozy cartoon

story: Mia, Sam, Leo, and Noor played a puzzle adventure. They searched their house and backyard to find missing pieces. They worked together and completed the puzzle of a tree. They felt proud and happy, knowing teamwork made their adventure fun.
